units.source_text: 夕雾回到南院，看见格子窗都已打开。

en.t: Yugiri returned to the southern residence and saw that all the lattice windows had been opened.

units.source_text: 又见昨夜恋恋不忍舍弃的那些花，现已尽行枯落，被吹得不知去向了。

en.t: He also saw that the flowers he had been so reluctant to leave the night before had now all withered and fallen, blown away to some unknown place.

units.source_text: 他从正阶拾级而上，将回书呈与父亲。

en.t: He climbed the main steps and presented the reply letter to his father.

units.source_text: 源氏拆看，但见信上写道：“昨夜我像小孩一般害怕，巴望你派人来此防御风灾。

en.t: Genji opened it and read: "Last night I was frightened like a child, and hoped you would send someone here to guard against the storm damage.

units.source_text: 今晨得信，心甚喜慰。”

en.t: Receiving your letter this morning has greatly gladdened and comforted my heart."

units.source_text: 看毕说道：“皇后胆怯得厉害啊！

en.t: When he finished reading, he said, "The Empress is terribly timid.

units.source_text: 不过，像昨夜那种模样，室内只有女人，的确是害怕的。

en.t: Still, with things as they were last night, and only women indoors, it truly must have been frightening.

units.source_text: 她想必在怪我疏慢了。”

en.t: She must be blaming me for being neglectful."

units.source_text: 便决定立刻前去探望。

en.t: He therefore decided to go and visit her at once.

units.source_text: 他想换件官袍，便撩起帘子，走入室内，把低矮的帷屏拉在一旁。

en.t: Wanting to change his court robe, he lifted the curtain, went inside, and drew the low screen curtain aside.

units.source_text: 夕雾望见帷屏旁边略微露出一个袖口，想必是紫姬了，不禁胸中别别地跳起来。

en.t: Yugiri glimpsed a sleeve slightly showing beside the screen curtain and, thinking it must be Lady Murasaki, felt his heart suddenly beat strangely fast.

units.source_text: 他自己觉得可恶，连忙回转头去向外面看。

en.t: Disgusted with himself, he quickly turned his head and looked outside.

units.source_text: 源氏照照镜子，低声对紫姬说道：“中将在晨光中，姿态很漂亮呢。

en.t: Genji looked in the mirror and said softly to Lady Murasaki, "The Lieutenant General looks very handsome in the morning light.

units.source_text: 他还只是个十五岁的孩子，我就觉得他美满无缺，怕是父母爱子的痴心吧？”

en.t: He is still only a fifteen-year-old child, yet I find him perfect in every way. Perhaps it is just a parent's fond blindness?"

units.source_text: 想必他对镜自视，觉得自己的相貌永远青春不老。

en.t: No doubt, looking at himself in the mirror, he felt that his own looks would remain forever youthful and unfading.

units.source_text: 他又说：“我见了皇后，总觉得有点儿拘束。

en.t: He went on, "Whenever I see the Empress, I always feel somewhat constrained.

units.source_text: 此人风姿虽不特别惹人注目，但气品异常高超，令人望而却步。

en.t: Her appearance is not especially striking, but her bearing is extraordinarily noble and makes one hesitate to approach.

units.source_text: 她确是个优雅婉娈的淑女，而性情又很坚贞。”

en.t: She is truly an elegant and gentle lady, and her character is also very steadfast."

units.source_text: 走出门来，看见夕雾正在坐着出神，一时连父亲出来都不觉察。

en.t: When he came out, he saw Yugiri sitting there lost in thought, not even noticing for a moment that his father had appeared.

units.source_text: 他很机敏，立刻心有所感，回进房里，便问紫姬：“昨天狂风发作时，中将看到了你么？

en.t: Being very perceptive, he immediately sensed something, went back into the room, and asked Lady Murasaki, "When the violent wind rose yesterday, did the Lieutenant General see you?

units.source_text: 那门开着呢。”

en.t: That door was open."

units.source_text: 紫姬脸红了，答道：“哪有这等事！

en.t: Lady Murasaki blushed and answered, "How could such a thing have happened?

units.source_text: 走廊里一点人声也没有。”

en.t: There was not the slightest sound of anyone in the corridor."

units.source_text: 源氏自言自语地说：“我总觉得奇怪。”

en.t: Genji said to himself, "It still seems strange to me."

units.source_text: 就带着夕雾出门。

en.t: Then he took Yugiri with him and went out.
